name: smtp-edc
description: SMTP Enhanced Diagnostics Client - Test and diagnose SMTP servers with comprehensive tools
long_description: SMTP-EDC is a powerful SMTP testing and diagnostic tool that provides comprehensive capabilities for testing email server connections, sending test emails, validating email addresses, and managing email templates. This extension brings full SMTP testing capabilities to your AI assistant through the Model Context Protocol.
